description.zh:
人像图片 Base64 编码。

说明

- 如果您选择该方式传入证件图片，请检查照片大小，不要传入过大的照片。
- FacePictureBase64 和 FacePictureUrl 和 FacePictureFile 三选一。
description.en:
The Base64-encoded face image.

> **Note**

- If you use this method to pass in the image, check the image size and do not pass in an excessively large image.
- Specify one of the following parameters: FacePictureBase64, FacePictureUrl, or FacePictureFile.
The file stream of the face image.

description.zh: 人脸照片地址。公网可访问的HTTPS链接
description.en: The URL of the face image. The URL must be a publicly accessible HTTPS URL.

description.zh:
是否检测人脸图片质量
- Y：开启
- N：关闭（默认）
description.en:
Specifies whether to check the quality of the face image. Valid values:
- Y: enabled.
- N: disabled. This is the default value.

description.zh: 商户侧自定义的业务唯一标识，用于后续定位排查问题使用。支持字母和数字的组合，长度最长32位，请确保唯一
description.en: The merchant-defined unique business ID for subsequent troubleshooting. The value can be a combination of letters and digits with a maximum length of 32 characters. Make sure the value is unique.

description.zh: 您自定义的用户ID，或者其他可以识别特定用户的标识，例如：手机号码、邮箱地址等。强烈建议对该字段的值进行预先脱敏，例如对值进行哈希处理。
description.en: The custom user ID or another identifier that can identify a specific user, such as a phone number or email address. We strongly recommend that you desensitize the value of this field in advance, for example, by hashing the value.

description.zh: 要接入的产品方案。取值FACE_LIVENESS_MIN_PRO / FACE_LIVENESS_MIN
description.en: The product plan to use. Valid values: FACE_LIVENESS_MIN_PRO and FACE_LIVENESS_MIN.

descriptions.zh: 调用FaceLivenessV2接口对人脸图片进行活体检测。
descriptions.en: Calls the FaceLivenessV2 operation to perform liveness detection on a face image.
